source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-21

procedures.title: Folding top material: clean
steps: Wash the top often with neutral soap suds, lukewarm water and a soft-bristle brush.
Rinse with plenty of clean water until no soap remains.
If still dirty, rinse the whole top, then apply a mild foaming cleanser to about two square feet at a time.
Scrub that area with a small soft-bristle hand brush, adding water until the cleaner foams up.
Wipe off the loosened dirt with a cloth or sponge before it gets ground into the fabric.
Apply more cleanser and keep scrubbing until clean.
notes: Caution: keep cleanser from running onto the body paint; it can leave streaks if it runs and dries.

procedures.title: Leather and coated fabrics: clean
steps: Wipe the surface now and then with a dry cloth.
When dirt builds up, use lukewarm water and neutral soap.
notes: Covers genuine leather and coated fabrics, including the vinyl coated formed headlining.
